speaker: Doctor
text: The TSH result indicates hypothyroidism, which can explain your fatigue and headaches; however, given your urgent claim of a stroke-level emergency, do you currently have any slurred speech, facial drooping, or sudden confusion? REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI.

speaker: Doctor
text: I am relieved the MRI is normal, which rules out a stroke. Since your TSH is elevated and your hemoglobin is borderline low, we are likely dealing with hypothyroidism, possibly contributing to your fatigue and headaches. Do you notice any sensitivity to cold or dry skin?

text: I do notice that I tend to feel colder than others in the room, and my skin has become quite dry lately. I also haven't noticed any changes in my bowel habits or swelling in my legs.
